scope: Synthetic headless Debug parsing and terminal picture recording; not app CPU, native input latency, GPU energy, or battery life.

source.xtermSourceComparison: All xterm Dart library sources match apart from line_picture_cache.dart; pubspec.lock identical.

design.snapshotMemoryLimit: Only rows retained by last painted frame; raw cell bytes exclude object overhead.
design.timed: ANSI parser plus picture recording/replay; excludes image rasterization/display and external processes
design.comparison: Median of 21 round means per variant/scenario; all observations retained.

validation.nativeLimit: Native Flutter rendering and injected framework input; does not establish physical keyboard/IME/display latency. Flutter launcher reported failure to foreground; tests connected and passed, so no foreground timing claim.
validation.initialFixtureCorrection: Unsupported circular-buffer .first getter fixed to [0]. The first check failed compilation; the final plan passed.
validation.normalBuildFirstAttempt: Failed before build because flutter was absent from PATH; rerun uses pinned SDK.
validation.normalReviewBuild: Passed with pinned Flutter; Impeller selected and strict bundle signature verified.

limits: Actual live workload differs from this fixture. No whole-app energy improvement or battery-menu clearance measured.

All-changed single-terminal control increased 30.75 microseconds (13.5%) for parse plus recording; four-terminal control increased 6.625 microseconds (0.7%). Snapshots are a bounded tradeoff, not a universal speedup.
The current machine runs other real apps and agents; owned benchmarks ran sequentially without concurrent owned builds/tests/profilers.
